description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal migration source plugin class 'Variable' for fetching configuration variables from a Drupal database during migration processes. It includes class properties, constructor, and methods for querying and retrieving variable data, with detailed configuration options and examples.

classes.name: Variable
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for fetching variables from the source Drupal database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Variable source plugin with configuration, migration, state, and entity type manager dependencies.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the variable values, either a single row or empty.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes variable data from the database based on configuration.

methods.name: doCount
methods.description: Counts the number of rows to be returned based on variable presence and configuration.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of variable names as field definitions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to select variable names and values.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the ID field for migration mapping.
